definition: A form used to calculate and claim this document based on qualified education expenses paid to eligible postsecondary educational institutions, including the American Opportunity Credit and the Lifetime Learning Credit.

includes.text: Form contains sections for calculating American Opportunity Credit and Lifetime Learning Credit
includes.quote: Education Credits (American Opportunity and Lifetime Learning Credits)

includes.text: Form requires entry of student information and educational institution details
Form includes comparison table of the two this document with eligibility requirements
Form contains worksheets for calculating adjusted qualified education expenses

excludes.text: Does not report interest income received by taxpayer
Does not contain itemized deduction categories
Does not calculate qualified business income deduction

discriminators.text: This form calculates this document for qualified tuition and education expenses; the sibling form itemizes personal deductions unrelated to education
discriminators.quote: Qualified education expenses include tuition and required enrollment fees

discriminators.text: This form computes this document for students at eligible institutions; the sibling form calculates a deduction for qualified business income
discriminators.quote: Education Credits (American Opportunity and Lifetime Learning Credits)

discriminators.text: This form calculates credits based on education expenses paid; the sibling form reports interest income received
